Today marks the 50th anniversary of Meals on Wheels!

I'm proud to support bipartisan legislation that recognizes the needs of critical nutrition programs for our seniors.
https://t.co/NE1cbmjTpb

Proud to help lead the Lymphedema Treatment Act over the finish line today. This bill will ensure Lymphedema patients on Medicare get the treatment they deserve. Too often these patients cannot get their basic care covered by Medicare. Not anymore.
https://t.co/KXXc6Jjpob
I just heard the news about @SenBobCasey's prostate cancer diagnosis. Please join me in sending thoughts and prayers to the Senator at this time.

Fighting fraud & preventing waste in the federal government is one of my top goals as Chairman of the Subcommittee on Tax. Today, @WaysandMeansGOP  is investigating the size, scope, & severity of stolen unemployment insurance funds after trillions were spent during the pandemic. https://t.co/SoK0NxkSEE

More than 800,000 Pennsylvanians, including 520,000 rural Pennsylvanians, lack quality broadband internet access. That's why today, I'm re-introducing the Broadband Grant Tax Treatment Act to make broadband more affordable and to expand access. Details⬇️
https://t.co/0sDxYQEGGX

Today, @WaysandMeansGOP is marking up the "Default Prevention Act" to fulfill the Full Faith and Credit of the United States, to serve seniors, and to prioritize our veterans.

Let's be clear: We will protect Medicare. We will  protect Social Security. We will pay our debts. https://t.co/ciweHrBULd

Great news! After the House passed my bill to reform  prior authorization rules, UnitedHealth has announced it will dramatically reduce its use of prior authorizations for Medicare Advantage patients, in addition to commercial & Medicaid patients.
https://t.co/F1iSDVh7R3

Thanks to the great team at the new Erie Cancer Wellness Center for hosting me and my team on Friday. We learned more about their work helping patients and their programs and services that promote physical, emotional, and mental healing. Thank you! https://t.co/fGdBCFqiZA

The majority of Congress agrees: by modernizing and streamlining the prior authorization process, seniors on Medicare can receive higher-quality care more quickly. That's why I'm leading an effort calling on @CMSGov to implement rules to do just that.⬇️
https://t.co/zcBWMDLF9k

In our democracy, it is simply un-American to hamper any individual's right to exercise their personally held religious and political views. That's why today I introduced the "Don't Weaponize The IRS Act." Details⬇️
https://t.co/Yr1ep3nGhb

Today, @WaysandMeansGOP is marking up two major pieces of health care policy, including the bill I'm co-leading -- the 'Improving Seniors’ Timely Access to Care Act.' This will make it easier for the 30+ million Americans on Medicare Advantage to get the care they need. https://t.co/ugNYyULQhY

The Improving Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act is simple: by modernizing and streamlining Medicare Advantage's prior authorization process, we are giving 30+ million Americans access to health care more quickly. I urge the full U.S. House to pass this incredible legislation! https://t.co/fhgP2iTaN0

From the future of the proposed French Creek National Wildlife Refuge to my legislation improving seniors' health care, I sat down this week with @Meadville_Trib to discuss the issues impacting our region and my plans to solve them.
https://t.co/ysUaCRIgtf

I'm proud to co-lead the bipartisan PROTECT Rare Act.  This critical legislation will support patients with rare and ultra-rare diseases in getting evidence-based, medically necessary care covered by their health insurance.
https://t.co/DJ7vjOaq6p

In FY23, 85% of all suspected terrorists encountered at land border ports of entry have crossed into the U.S. along the Northern border. This is a serious security threat to our nation. More coverage about my testimony to @JudiciaryGOP in @ButlerEagle⬇️
https://t.co/0FrhHhZg8S

Proud to join @RepBera on this critical legislation that will strengthen pediatric brain cancer data collection. It is our hope that this legislation will improve both patient treatment and patient outcomes.
https://t.co/YRbU2KJbKO

@WaysandMeansGOP is continuing to fight for patients. Learn more ⬇
https://t.co/FP7yYl7WmO

I recently spoke with @newsnationnow about the surge of migrant encounters and concerns about suspected terrorists crossing into the U.S. through our Northern border. More must be done to secure ALL of America's borders.

FULL STORY: https://t.co/29rkSRpYq1 https://t.co/kMWdn3UMBW

Did you miss last night's telephone town hall on Medicare Open Enrollment? You can listen to the full replay here!⬇️
https://t.co/aE8UkXikyS

Thank you to the nearly 5,800 #PA16 residents who joined last night's Medicare Open Enrollment telephone town hall! Each and every day, my team and I are here to serve you. Here is just some of the feedback from our neighbors about how this town hall helped them. https://t.co/x5lDesViqj

On Saturday, I was honored to meet with Richard & Melanie Mellon to learn more about their vision for the future of North East's Granite Ridge site. The Mellons are working to transform it into a veterans outreach & wellness center. I commend their investment in the community! https://t.co/e1C29WGKn2

I'm proud to support The Lower Costs, More Transparency Act because it:
✅Increases price transparency throughout the health care system
✅Addresses the cost of prescription drugs
✅Supports patients and health care workers

Learn more⬇️
https://t.co/fAI7Gqc9PN

For years, my Congressional colleagues and I have focused on improving patient access and cutting wait times through prior authorization reforms. Today's new CMS rule will go a long way toward helping the 32 million Americans who are currently enrolled in Medicare Advantage.

Today, on #RareDiseaseDay, we recognize the more than 25 million Americans living with at least one of the more than 7,000 known rare diseases or disorders. I'm proud to lead the PROTECT Rare Act, which supports patients with rare & ultra-rare diseases.
https://t.co/vgU3yooPcd

This year, I invited Laura Crago of Butler County to the State of the Union Address. Laura hosts a podcast at the @ButlerEagle addressing treatments and stigma surrounding mental health and addiction in Butler County and across the United States. https://t.co/kPxv3IsYPL
